title: Jallikattu Kaalai
desc: Gopalkrishnan, an ordinary mill worker, falls in love with the mill owner's daughter. However, a vicious landlord causes a stir in their lives.

title: Velundu Vinaiyillai
desc: Karpagam is being ill-treated by her stepmother, who intends to usurp all her ill husband's wealth. Karpagam's grandfather learns about her plight and sends his trusted aide, Arun, to help her.

title: Paalum Pazhamum
desc: Dr Ravi struggles to find a drug that can cure the deadliest cancer. However, when he is close to accomplishing his goal, he gets distracted because of his beloved assistant Shanthi's illness.

title: Nilaave Vaa
desc: Siluvai, a Christian man, wants to get married to Sangeetha, a Hindu woman who is already engaged to Siva. Her father is against their union, but Siva decides to help them.
